characters.name: Hu Tao (Genshin Impact)
characters.description: Hu Tao has long brown hair styled in twintails with a prominent ahoge, adorned with red and pink plum blossom hair ornaments and small branches. Her large red eyes feature glowing flower-shaped pupils. She wears a navy blue school uniform blazer with gold buttons over a white collared shirt and a red necktie, paired with a beige plaid pleated skirt. Her fingernails are painted black, and she wears a red bead bracelet on her right wrist. She holds a small, smiling white ghost plushie with red markings close to her chest. Her expression is playful, with flushed cheeks and her tongue sticking out slightly. A black backpack with two emoji pins and a round charm featuring an eye symbol, tassels, and red flowers hangs on her back.

caption.General: Hu Tao from Genshin Impact stands outdoors near a wrought-iron gate and stone wall, bathed in warm sunlight with soft shadows and lens flare. She is centered in a close-up, slightly low-angle view, holding a small white ghost plushie. The background includes greenery and a peaceful garden-like setting.
